hypothesis: A pitcher's level drifts across seasons, but within-pitcher sensitivity to batter hand, two-strike situations, and runners on base may persist. Effect-coded completed-history differentials can add stable information without importing stale pitcher levels.

data_contract.deployment_feature: frozen prior-season pitcher/context table plus the current row's pitcher_id and context

estimator.effect_coding: subtract the history-frequency-weighted mean cell effect within each pitcher
estimator.application: add gamma times the sum of selected context effects to exact-C on R rows; F stays exact-C

selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
fewer contexts, smaller gamma, larger k, longer history
